targets.query: default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']), repository=tostring(resource['code.repository.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 40

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | summarize input_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['input_tokens'])), output_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['output_tokens'])), cache_read_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['cache_read_tokens'])) by day=bin(timestamp, 1d), model=tostring(attributes['model']) | sort by day asc

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']), repository=tostring(resource['code.repository.id']), feature=tostring(resource['business.feature.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 100

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize input_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['input_tokens'])), cache_read_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['cache_read_tokens'])), cache_creation_tokens=sum(toint(attributes['cache_creation_tokens'])) by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']) | extend cache_hit_ratio=cache_read_tokens/(input_tokens+cache_read_tokens) | sort by input_tokens desc | take 50

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | where isnotempty(tostring(attributes['vcs.pull_request.id'])) | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])), requests=count() by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']), pull_request=tostring(attributes['vcs.pull_request.id']) | sort by cost_usd desc | take 100

default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by month=bin(timestamp, 30d), project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']) | sort by month asc | take 2000

panels.title: AI spend per commit by project

targets.query: let spend=default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where attributes['event.name'] == 'api_request' | summarize cost_usd=sum(todouble(attributes['cost_usd'])) by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']); let delivery=default | where timestamp >= now() - 90d | where resource['service.name'] == 'claude-code' | where metric_name == 'claude_code.commit.count' | summarize commits=sum(toint(value)) by project=tostring(resource['business.project.id']); spend | join kind=leftouter delivery on project | extend cost_per_commit=cost_usd/commits | project project, cost_usd, commits, cost_per_commit | sort by cost_usd desc | take 100
